Entries.Name: Night Time Playground
Entries.Author: Jayraiya
Entries.Description:
Makes it night.

Comes with a moon you can recolour and resize, stars, fireflies over the water, and crickets.

Press N to toggle night. Everything else is in the Environment tab.

Entries.Name: Reflective Water
Entries.Author: Jayraiya
Entries.Description: Adds reflections to water. Settings are in the Environment tab.
